notes.title: Steam Drops? We Need Your Power! 🚀
notes.content: [p]Salutations, High Rollers! 💎[/p][p]We've been working behind the scenes on creating unique designs to bring exclusive drops to the Steam Market. Our goal is to deliver collectible items that truly reflect the spirit of [i]Im Rich[/i] — premium and unforgettable. [/p][p][/p][p]🚀 We need your help to make it happen! 🚀[/p][p]We've already completed all the required steps ✅ — now the only thing standing between us and full Steam Workshop access (including the Market) is visibility. That means more in-game hours, more momentum, and more High Rollers joining the cause. Every bit of activity counts, and together we can launch [i]Im Rich[/i] to the next level. 📈[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, we’re working on mockups to have everything ready the moment we hit the goal. We want the drops to feel as polished and exclusive as the game itself. Take a sneak peek below — we're just getting started. 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345081/fd4893708d1215d6d315207479925f79bf85e23b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
